title: limpet global settings file
description: Global app settings (~/.config/limpet/settings.json). Mirrors ONLY the safe, enumerated subset of LimpetSettings — see AppSettingsFileStore.SafeKey.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema file. Written automatically; safe to ignore.

debugLoggingEnabled.description: Verbose debug logging for file watchers and sync triggers.

launchAtLogin.description: Whether limpet starts automatically at login (SMAppService login item).
